name: Kagami Ren
source:
Daughter of Yuri and a childhood friend of the protagonist Akira, Ren has been taught about loving a man from her mother and is more than willing to try it out for herself. She is a first year student and Akira tutors her on her homework.
She calls Akira "Onii-chan" despite them not being related. She is short, but glamorous.
